name: The Component Gallery
purpose: Cross-design-system component intelligence source. Use for taxonomy, aliases, interaction distinctions, accessibility guidance, source comparison and implementation research; do not treat examples as clone templates.
rightsPolicy: Component Gallery is used as a reference/index source, not as permission to copy downstream design-system code or screenshots.
Each downstream design system retains its own licence and terms; verify those before source reuse.
Store normalized metadata, aliases, behavioral distinctions and source links rather than mirrored screenshots.
Prefer original implementation or an explicitly licensed implementation library such as HeroUI when it fits the target stack.
